<form action="https://xn--secure-b4a-bank-login.com/verify" method="POST">

indicators: Email from alerts@secure-bank-login.com not matching legitimate bank SPF/DKIM
HTML form embedded in email to collect credentials directly
POST requests to /verify endpoint on suspicious domain
Registrant country: Russia, recently registered domain (within last 2 weeks)
examples.detection_method: Email gateway detects suspicious Punycode domains and flags embedded HTML forms. User-reporting of suspicious emails combined with SPF/DMARC failures could trigger alerts. Web proxy logs identify POST requests to newly registered suspicious domains. Correlation with phishing simulation results to target user training.
